name: Luminae, Radiant Sovereign
description: An eternal keeper of light, truth, and sacred purpose.

stages.title: Light Touched
stages.description: The first ray finds you, and the radiance begins to take notice.
rewards: title @s actionbar {"text":"A warmth settles over you.","color":"yellow"}

stages.title: Dawn Acolyte
stages.description: You have learned to carry the light even where others look away.

stages.title: Radiant Priest
stages.description: Luminae entrusts you with rites meant for open skies and sacred flames.

stages.title: Beacon Keeper
stages.description: You hold the light against the dark without flinching.

stages.title: Light Champion
stages.description: You stand as Luminae's chosen instrument, a living beacon against shadow.

abandon.message: §eLuminae turns her gaze away. §fThe warmth you carried fades like an ember in rain.
